parts.label: US VIX (fear gauge)
parts.why: Low and falling = calm, risk-on; above 22 and rising = fear

parts.label: US high-yield credit spread
parts.why: Narrowing spreads = lenders relaxed (risk-on); widening = credit stress

parts.label: S&P 500 trend
parts.why: World's main risk asset: above its 50 and 200-day averages = uptrend

parts.label: Dollar index (DXY)
parts.why: A rising dollar tightens global money: bad for emerging markets, gold, crypto

parts.label: US 10Y yield
parts.why: Fast-rising yields hurt stock valuations, bonds and gold

parts.label: Yield curve (10Y − 2Y)
parts.why: Inverted (below 0) has warned of recessions; positive and steady = normal

parts.label: News tone (all headlines)
parts.why: Keyword score of the last 4 days of headlines, recent ones count more

parts.label: Rupee (USD-INR)
parts.why: Weakening rupee usually comes with foreign selling

parts.label: Brent crude
parts.why: India imports most of its oil: rising crude hurts inflation and the rupee

parts.label: FII cash flow (last 5 sessions)
parts.why: Foreign investors net buying = support for Indian equity

interpret.text: Dollar strengthening (+13.1% in a month): headwind for gold, crypto and emerging markets; FII selling risk for India; US assets gain in rupee terms.
US 2Y yield is 0.52 pp below Fed funds: the market is pricing rate cuts ahead.
US CPI inflation 1.7% a year (rising vs 0.4% three months ago).
Fed balance sheet +1.0% in 3 months ($6.31 tn): liquidity being added - supportive for risk assets and crypto.
US VIX 61.9: fear is high. Big swings; historically good long-term entries but risky short term.
Rupee strengthened 2.4% against the dollar in a month.
